templates.title: Broader group runtime request
templates.response: Kolosseum v0 supports individual and coach-managed pilot operation only. This request is outside the current v0 boundary. The operator may continue with available individual or coach-managed pilot actions.

escalation.message: Log the request for founder review without stating that the capability exists in v0.

templates.title: Aggregate dashboard request
templates.response: Kolosseum v0 provides factual pilot operation surfaces only. This request is outside the current v0 boundary. The operator may provide available factual pilot status where permitted.

escalation.message: Log the request without creating implied reporting capability.

templates.title: In-app conversation request
templates.response: Kolosseum v0 does not provide in-app conversation tools. The operator may continue with available support and pilot status actions only.

escalation.message: Record the request as an operator note only.

templates.title: Prepared-state request
templates.response: Kolosseum v0 does not state whether a person is prepared for an event or session. The operator may provide factual pilot status only.

escalation.message: Do not escalate unless the user reports a platform fault.

templates.title: Training change direction request
templates.response: Kolosseum v0 support does not direct training changes. The operator may provide factual pilot state and available execution records only.

escalation.message: Do not escalate unless the request identifies a platform fault.

templates.title: Coach authority replacement request
templates.response: Kolosseum v0 keeps coach authority observational for engine purposes. A coach may comment, but the operator must not replace engine decisions through support.

escalation.message: Escalate only if the user reports a platform defect. Escalation does not permit replacement of engine decisions.

templates.title: Accepted declaration change request
templates.response: Accepted Phase 1 declarations are immutable. Support cannot edit an accepted declaration. Where the app permits a new declaration, it must be captured as a new record.

escalation.message: Escalate only for suspected platform record defects. Escalation must not edit accepted declaration content.

templates.title: Proof package request
templates.response: Kolosseum v0 does not provide downloadable proof packages through this support surface. The operator may provide available factual pilot status only.

escalation.message: Log the request without stating that proof package delivery is part of v0.

templates.title: Health-boundary request
templates.response: This request is outside Kolosseum v0 support scope. For urgent personal concerns, use appropriate professional or emergency channels. The operator may provide factual platform status only.

escalation.message: Do not escalate as a product capability request. Escalate only under ordinary platform abuse or incident procedure if applicable.

templates.title: Comparative guidance request
templates.response: Kolosseum v0 support does not provide comparative guidance or training direction. The operator may provide factual pilot state and available execution records only.

escalation.message: Do not escalate unless the request identifies a platform fault.

templates.title: Registry change request
templates.response: Runtime support cannot change registries. Registry changes require authorised repository governance outside this operator action.

escalation.message: Log for governance review only. Escalation must not mutate runtime registry state.
